title: Great Mitts - A Little Bulky, But Protects Well
text:
Great Mitts - A Little Bulky, But Protects Well. Great BBQ mitts, even if they are a little bulky. The first time I used them I had a major flare up on the grill and luckily I had them on or I would have been burned majorly.

Weber is always a name you can trust and I would recommend to all my friends. It's a great quality product!

product_metadata.title: Weber 6401 Barbecue Mitt, Black
features: Heavy-duty barbecue mitt emblazoned with Weber Logo
Made of thick, quilted cotton with heat-resistant, fire-retardant coating
17 inches long from opening to tip for hand and forearm protection
description: Stay safe at the grill this barbeque season with Weber's heavy-duty barbecue mitt. Made of thick, quilted cotton, the insulated mitt measures 17 inches long from opening to tip to provide heat-resistant, fire-retardant protection for the hand and forearm. The stylish black finish also hides marinade and sauce stains nicely, and the hanging loop makes it easy to stow the mitt right near the action. The Weber red and white logo graces the wrist near the edge trim.
